turns.question: What was the median gap in hours between consecutive orders of the same customer in September 2026, counting only customers with at least two orders?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for the median gap in hours between a customer's consecutive orders, so I cannot give that figure. The closest metrics it has are Orders (orders_total), Active customers (customers_distinct) and Average order value (EUR), and none of them measures the time between orders.
